# Cambridge Dictionary

> > Comprehensive bilingual dictionary providing English-French translations with definitions, examples from the Cambridge English Corpus, and coverage of idioms, phrasal verbs, and specialized vocabulary.

Cambridge Dictionary offers authoritative English-French translations powered by Cambridge University Press, drawing on corpus data from sources including Europarl Parallel Corpus and Hansard archives. The dictionary serves language learners and translators with detailed entries covering everyday vocabulary, idiomatic expressions, and domain-specific terminology.

- English-French translation

## Common Words and Phrases

- [ADAPT | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/adapt): English-French translation for verb 'adapt' (s'adapter)
- [ACTUAL | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/actual): English-French translation for 'actual' (réel, véritable)
- [ACCOUNTABLE in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/accountable): English-French translation for 'accountable' (responsable)
- [ACCEPTED in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/accepted): English-French translation for 'accepted' (reconnu)
- [AESTHETIC in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/aesthetic): English-French translation for 'aesthetic' (esthétique)
- [ABUNDANTLY in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/abundantly): English-French translation for adverb 'abundantly' (abondamment)
- [ABIDING | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/abiding): English-French translation for adjective 'abiding' (durable)
- [ADAPTOR | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/adaptor): English-French translation for 'adaptor' (adaptateur)
- [ADHESION in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/adhesion): English-French translation for 'adhesion' (adhérence, adhésion)
- [ADHERE | translate English to French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/adhere): English-French translation for verb 'adhere' (adhérer, coller)
- [ACCLIMATIZE in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/acclimatize): English-French translation for 'acclimatize' (s'acclimater)
